failures.toolFailed: Tool {tool} failed: {reason}. Do not call it again more than once. Continue with the evidence you already have, and state in your rationale which evidence you could not check.

get_task_events.limit: Max events to return in this page (default 100, hard cap 300)
get_task_events.cursor: Opaque cursor from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit to start from the first page.
get_task_events.order: Reading direction: "asc" (default) pages from the earliest event forward; "desc" pages from the latest event backward.

descriptions.get_task_events: Get a page of a task's chronological event sequence (user messages, assistant messages, tool runs), up to 300 events per page. You choose how much to read: pick limit, pass the response's nextCursor back as cursor to keep paging, and set order="desc" to start from the latest events (e.g. to see how a long task ended). truncated/total tell you whether more events exist. Call this when the conversation excerpt in the prompt is too thin to name the work.
